row.body: The pump key is clipped to an opening sheet that counts the pumps but not the vehicles still waiting outside.
row.title: The station count

sidecar.gloss: An opening checklist omits the waiting vehicles.
sidecar.rival_reading: A field crew could have left vehicles queued for ordinary work; the sheet does not say why the count stopped.

row.body: matching white stripes cross the warning whistle and first-aid kit. a name-sized patch on the warning whistle has been scrubbed bare.
row.title: missing count beside the warning whistle

sidecar.gloss: A response bundle preserves a missing count, changed route, or erased identity.
sidecar.rival_reading: A farm-program crew could have counted routes, repacked tools, or removed ownership marks during hurried field work; the objects do not prove a concealed public response.
